shoe_reaction_and_unloading.coordinate_definition: Wheel planeX/Z; point angletheta measured from+Xradius; positiveangularvelocity about+Y. Shoe force onwheel is(-N*cos(theta)-s*Ft*sin(theta), -N*sin(theta)+s*Ft*cos(theta)) in(X,Z), where s=sign(omega_y).
shoe_reaction_and_unloading.ideal_opposed_clasp: Two equally loaded diametrically opposite shoes cancel their vector normal/friction resultants while their brake torques add. Normalforce sum remainsT/(mu*r); eachshoehalf only withactualequalization. Wear, frictionvariation, position and riggingcompliance can break cancellation.
shoe_reaction_and_unloading.nonhorizontal_shoes: At other angles the normal force itself has a vertical component, potentially larger than tangential force. No unchangedwheelunloadingclaim is made.
shoe_reaction_and_unloading.rail_adhesion_distinction: Block/rotor friction coefficient is not wheel-rail adhesion; increasing actuator force can lock wheels before meeting demandedvehicledeceleration on lowadhesion rail.
shoe_reaction_and_unloading.single_shoe_at_horizontal_diameter_front: At the front or rear point on the horizontal wheel diameter (theta 0 or 180 degrees), the local tangent and friction force are vertical; the normal force is horizontal. A single shoe therefore introduces ±Ft vertical force on wheel, with direction reversed by travel. This is a component-force sensitivity, not a prediction of final wheel unloading; bearings, frame, primary suspension, rail contact and completevehicleloadtransfer must be solved together.

suspension_tracking.axle_tilt_and_lateral_float: Need complete articulation and contact-envelope checks against final wheel/profile/axleboxgeometry.
suspension_tracking.tracking_is_not_wear_adjustment: Slack adjuster maintains usable actuator stroke as friction material/wheelwear changes. It does not by itself accommodate suspension heave, axle tilt, lateral motion or maintain pad/shoe alignment.
suspension_tracking.tread_candidate: Defined hanger/brakehead articulation or a supplier flexible tread unit, with shoe/head/beam retention and wheelmovement clearance.
suspension_tracking.disc_candidate: Defined suspended/floating caliper or qualified axle-following support; a rigid caliper attached to sprungframe cannot be assumed to track fullaxletravel.
suspension_tracking.retention_not_redundancy: A safetycatch/hanger that prevents droppedrigging reachingtrack is not automatically an independent functioningtorquepath or secondbrake.

actuator_and_mount_load_basis.requirement: Mount,beam,lever,pins,shoehead and rotor/hub design loads must derive from selectedcomponent maximumcredibleoutput acrosspressure,stroke,tolerances,adjustment,frictionandfaultcases. Demandedworkingtorque is not this limit.
actuator_and_mount_load_basis.formula: N_shoes = F_actuator * actual_mechanical_advantage * efficiency, subjecttoarticulation/contact; reactionvectors and eachmountleverarm must then be resolved.
output_cases_needed: Maximum springparking force over fullwear/releasestroke; pneumaticpressurecontrol doesnotlimit mechanicalspring force.

documented_unselected_service_actuator_e.selection_status: Documented service-only actuator example, not selected forC5.1 and not railway-qualified here.
documented_unselected_service_actuator_e.curve_note: These are reference labels on varying force-stroke curves, not constant force for allstroke or maximumoutputratings. Drawing ±5%band appliesonly10–40mmstroke. No10bar outputcurve retrieved.

analytical_gross_pressure_area_screen.formula: F=P*A, with1bar=0.1N/mm² andA=pi*136²/4;return spring and friction ignored.
analytical_gross_pressure_area_screen.classification: Conservative static pneumatic-force screening assumption using full chamber inner projected area; not OEM output rating or independentlyverifiedmaximum. Effective-area bound requires manufacturer confirmation. Impact,inertia,mechanicalstop andinstallationloads are additional.
analytical_gross_pressure_area_screen.mount_load_use: Any laterrigging must propagate this provisionalforce envelope or a confirmedhighercredibleforce through actual levergeometry; do notsize mounts from363.825Nmworkingdemand or8barcurve alone.

documented_unselected_service_actuator_e.parking_status: Service chamber only; its return spring is not a spring-applied parking brake. Separateparkingarchitecture remainsopen.
documented_unselected_service_actuator_e.articulation_note: Manufacturer pushrod articulation limits are small and do not permit treating cylinderrod as the suspensiontrackingjoint.
